notes.title: New GUI in progress!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I'm happy to announce that we have started working on the implementation of a whole new GUI for our game. Our team is very small, so I guess it will take us a month (or a little bit more), but the next update will be amazing for sure ;)

You can take a look on this concepts, to see what's coming (ignore the texts, some are in Spanish, and some in English)

notes.title: New update available!
notes.notes:
Hello there, community! We decided to release an update early, to fix a couple of horrible bugs that shouldn't wait longer: the poor broken girls of Pink Riot, a locale fix for Linux, and a couple of other minor bugs and text corrections.

There are probably more polishes to be done, but we prefer to get the most noticeable ones fixed first, since we are a very small team. If you find anything, please don't hesitate to report it on this forums.

We deeply apology for these bad issues, and we'll continue to improve our game. Feedback is always welcomed :)
